item.title: Iran’s Regime Exposed: Billion-Dollar Crypto Network Used to Evade Sanctions and Fund Proxy Groups - Iran News Update
item.description: A German media report uncovers a secret Iranian financial network using cryptocurrency and shell companies to bypass sanctions, move over $1 billion, and fund proxy groups.

item.title: Iranian Opposition Voices Unite: Organized Resistance Presented as Only Path to Change - Iran News Update
item.description: Interviews with Iranian opposition figures and coverage from Brussels highlight calls for regime change, rejection of war and appeasement, and support for a democratic transition plan.

item.title: Iranian Opposition Supporter Calls for Recognition of Transitional Government - Iran News Update
item.description: In an interview with Italian media, an Iranian opposition supporter outlines the role of resistance units, calls for regime change, and urges recognition of a transitional government.

item.title: U.S. Moves to Dismantle Iran’s Cyber Repression Network - Iran News Update
item.description: The U.S. Justice Department has seized four domains tied to Iran’s intelligence services, uncovering cyber-enabled psychological operations targeting dissidents, journalists, and foreign entities.

item.title: Iran’s Future Will Be Decided from Within, Says Opposition Figure - Iran News Update
item.description: Iranian opposition figure Alireza Jafarzadeh says regime change must come from within Iran, rejecting foreign military involvement and warning against repeating the 1953 coup.

item.title: The Only Viable Path for Iran Lies Within Its People - Iran News Update
item.description: Iran’s organized resistance argues that only internal forces—not foreign intervention or appeasement—can bring democratic change, backed by a long-standing political alternative.

item.title: Wave of Arrests Sweeps Iran Amid War and Internet Blackout - Iran News Update
item.description: Reports indicate widespread arrests across Iran during wartime conditions and a prolonged internet blackout, raising serious concerns over repression and lack of transparency.

item.title: Maryam Rajavi’s Ten-Point Plan: A Credible Blueprint for Iran’s Democratic Transition - Iran News Update
item.description: Maryam Rajavi’s Ten-Point Plan, highlights a democratic framework, is gaining international support as a roadmap for Iran’s transition from dictatorship to democracy.

item.title: After Khamenei: Between Illusion and Reality in Iran’s Political Future - Iran News Update
item.description: John Bercow’s remarks on Iran’s post-Khamenei landscape, highlights the regime’s fragility, the risks of superficial alternatives, and the case for a structured democratic opposition.

item.title: Neither Appeasement nor War: Why Democratic Change in Iran Is the Only Viable Path - Iran News Update
item.description: The democratic change strategy proposed by Maryam Rajavi, argues that empowering the Iranian people—not appeasement or war—is the only sustainable solution to Iran’s crisis.
